rationale: Correct the canonical holding to SP Solar Holdings I, LP, the Delaware limited partnership identified in Southern Power's SEC filings, and retain Southern Power solar and storage portfolio as a public-facing alias. APG did not acquire Southern Power Company; it acquired the 33% passive limited-partner interest in SP Solar from Global Atlantic in November 2023 through Scarlet Renewables LLC. Southern Power remains the 67% majority owner, general partner through wholly owned subsidiaries, and operating controller. APG Asset Management US's March 25, 2026 Form ADV continues to list Scarlet Renewables LLC as an APG-managed infrastructure private fund, and Southern Company's June 30, 2026 filing continues to report the same 67%/33% partnership economics. No APG exit, transfer, or pending sale was found through August 8, 2026. Retire the separate Southern Power repository row because it is an erroneous APG-attributed parent-level PortCo record, not because Southern Power Company and SP Solar are the same legal entity. The resulting technical redirect preserves old repository links only; Southern Power is deliberately excluded from the canonical alias list. Preserve the two unique parent-context milestones, explicitly consolidate the duplicate ownership and milestone rows, retain legacy historical facts, add direct current ownership and identity evidence, and remove duplicate or irrelevant citations. The November 14, 2023 date is the completed-sale disclosure date; no separate legal closing date is inferred in this phase-one schema.

beforeImage.name: Southern Power solar portfolio
beforeImage.subsector: Contracted utility-scale solar and storage portfolio
beforeImage.description: This portfolio consists of Southern Power-managed operating solar facilities and battery storage assets across multiple U.S. states. Its customers are utilities and other power purchasers served under long-term power contracts rather than merchant market exposure. The portfolio follows an asset-heavy contracted operating model with Southern Power remaining general partner and operating manager of the underlying projects. Public disclosures describe 26 operating solar facilities and two battery storage projects totaling approximately 2.2 gigawatts across six states. The portfolio traces back to a 2018 minority sale to Global Atlantic and was later recapitalized when APG acquired that minority interest in 2023. APG acquired the 33% minority stake from Global Atlantic in November 2023, while Southern Power retained the remaining interest and operating control.

afterImage.name: SP Solar Holdings I, LP
aliases: Southern Power solar and storage portfolio
afterImage.subsector: Contracted utility-scale solar and battery storage portfolio
afterImage.description: SP Solar Holdings I, LP is a Delaware limited partnership that indirectly owns substantially all of Southern Power's solar and battery energy storage facilities. Southern Power controls the partnership through wholly owned subsidiaries, holds 67%, and operates and maintains the assets; APG holds the 33% passive limited-partner interest through Scarlet Renewables LLC after acquiring it from Global Atlantic in November 2023. The assets supply utilities and other power purchasers under long-term contracts across multiple U.S. states. Southern Company's June 2026 filing continued to report the 67%/33% economics and Southern Power control, while APG's March 2026 regulatory filing continued to list Scarlet Renewables as an APG-managed infrastructure vehicle.
